speaker: anne_shakespeare
text: Joan has the three of them. If we are not back by dark she will have opinions, and I would rather have the path while it is still ours.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: The stubble is short. Whose was this close, before thy father?

speaker: anne_shakespeare
text: A man who held it before him, and who would not mend a hedge. That is the whole pedigree. The long hedge, Bartholomew laid, the year Susanna was born. He still walks it when he thinks we are not looking.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Twelve years of a hedge is a long work to leave unnamed.

speaker: anne_shakespeare
text: Then leave it unnamed. You have the use of it. You do not have the holder's name, and I am not giving you one to put in a speech.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: And the next close.

speaker: anne_shakespeare
text: Shottery ground. My father held the headland. The ditch is ours to clean. I am telling you the uses, because you walk this path as if it were a road into a play.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I am listening.

speaker: anne_shakespeare
text: Then listen to the ditch as a ditch. It wants cleaning. It does not want a scene.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: And the stile.

speaker: anne_shakespeare
text: A cousin broke an arm there at seven, showing off. We set the arm in the yard. He howled more at the disgrace than at the bone.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: There is a tale in that. A boy, a stile, and the arm the least of it. You could put it on a stage and the yard would know who was in the right.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: No. That was thine. I had the turn already made, and it was not mine to make.

speaker: anne_shakespeare
text: I heard you stop.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I heard me too. Late, but I heard it.

speaker: anne_shakespeare
text: Good. The eighteenth, then. The carrier, the bridge, and you with him.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I'll walk. What I carry is the pack, the sheets, and the inkhorn. Nothing that needs a speech at the door.

speaker: anne_shakespeare
text: The horses go at a horse's pace, not at yours. If you mean to keep with them, you keep with them. I will not have a letter that says you were clever and footsore.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: A horse's pace. I will not improve it.

speaker: anne_shakespeare
text: Don't improve it. Come up to the yard. He will be in the door, and he will not come down the path to fetch us.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: What will he say of the wheat?

speaker: anne_shakespeare
text: He will say it is thin. He will not want a fifth word, and you are not to offer one.

speaker: bartholomew_hathaway
text: Thin wheat. Leave it.

speaker: anne_shakespeare
text: That is the harvest, in four words. You have seen it. You need not add a fifth.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I won't.

speaker: anne_shakespeare
text: Then we can walk the last of it without a tale. The thatch is the thatch. The path is the path.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: The eighteenth stays the eighteenth. I have said the pack once. I will not say it again for company.
